notes.title: New Updates
Updated Version Announcement
notes.notes:
Dear players,
League of Angels: Pact will go offline and be updated to the latest new version from 02:00 - 03:00, on July.18th, (EST). 
We have updated the following content:
1. The new Void Angel - Kay has been added to the limited-time summoning (visible on Monday after 169 days of server opening).
2. Gift pack update - added Specialty Pack.
3. Added the red skill inscription - Silent Resistance (sold in the Specialty Pack).
4. Optimise the data display of the Angel bond.
5. Fix known bugs.
Thank you for supporting League of Angels: Pact.
